name: deed.page
description: Publish static files (HTML or a whole site) to a permanent HTTPS URL on a deed.page subdomain, then update, roll back, list versions, attach custom domains or delete them; the first publish needs no account and returns an owner token.

inputs.label: deed.page Owner Token
inputs.description: Optional. Leave empty to start: the first publish_site call returns an owner token. Paste it here so later sessions can update, roll back or delete the sites it owns.

obtain.instructions:
1. Connect without a token and ask the agent to publish a page (publish_site)
2. Copy the token field from that first publish result (starts with deed_tok_)
3. Paste it here; it controls every site published with it

auth.instructions: Works without a token: the first publish creates one. Add that owner token via the Authorization: Bearer header to manage existing sites across sessions.
